verificationNotes: These are the two 'panoramic refuges' installed in 2021 in the Cheile Bicazului-Hășmaș National Park by the Gyilkostó Adventure Association with Salvamont Harghita (Agerpres/stiripesurse 17 Jun 2021; digi24 9 Aug 2021; visitharghita), built of wood and aluminium modules flown in by helicopter. Both are in OSM: (A, chosen) Piatra Poienii / Mária-kő cabin, node 9230390942, 46.808744, 25.818644, commune Bicaz-Chei, Neamț – directly above the Bicaz Gorges and matching the project county Neamț; (B, alternative) Gyilkos-havasi panorámakabin on Piatra Ucigașului/Gyilkos-kő above Lacu Roșu, node 9234777918, 46.786247, 25.798253, Gheorgheni, Harghita. Which of the two appears in the single archive image could not be determined without viewing it – confirm visually (B sits on the Gyilkos-kő summit cliff, A on the Piatra Poienii cliff edge over the gorge). OSM holds only points, no outlines.
